versions.write_note_description: Write a durable note (<= 8192 characters). Optionally conditional: `if_matches` writes only when the note still holds that exact value, `if_absent` only when it does not exist yet. Send one condition, not both. A failed condition reports the value that is actually there.

versions.write_note_description: Write a durable note (<= 8192 characters). Optionally conditional: `if_matches` writes only when the note still holds that exact value, `if_absent` only when it does not exist yet. Send one condition, not both.
